title: SCTransNet: Spatial-Channel Cross Transformer Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
venue_or_source: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing 62
relevance_note: Exact host baseline: SCTB/SSCA mixes all encoder levels through channel-cross attention and redistributes them to decoders; any new claim must be a specific repair of this operator, not generic cross-scale fusion.
quality_note: Peer-reviewed journal; stable DOI and public arXiv/code exist; inspect exact split and checkpoint protocol before numerical comparison.

title: Miss Detection vs. False Alarm: Adversarial Learning for Small Object Segmentation in Infrared Images
relevance_note: Directly establishes that miss detection and false alarm can require opposing treatment and explicitly decomposes them; blocks any broad first-to-separate-target-and-false-alarm claim.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; multi-dataset experiments and explicit MD/FA formulation.

title: Asymmetric Contextual Modulation for Infrared Small Target Detection
relevance_note: Introduces top-down global feedback plus bottom-up point-wise channel modulation and the SIRST dataset; close cross-level context baseline and benchmark source.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; public dataset and code; dataset identity/split must be matched exactly.

title: Attentional Local Contrast Networks for Infrared Small Target Detection
venue_or_source: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing 59
relevance_note: Combines an explicit local-contrast prior with bottom-up attention, so static rarity/contrast support alone is not a defensible novelty claim.
quality_note: Peer-reviewed journal; DOI resolves publisher record; public arXiv and code are available.

title: Dense Nested Attention Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
relevance_note: Dense nested cross-level interaction and cascaded channel/spatial attention preserve small targets; introduces NUDT-SIRST and target-level Pd/Fa evaluation.
quality_note: Peer-reviewed journal with ablations, multiple datasets, public dataset/code and explicit metric definitions.

title: ISNet: Shape Matters for Infrared Small Target Detection
relevance_note: Adds edge/shape-aware blocks and introduces IRSTD-1K; strongest source for the hard clutter benchmark and a non-routing structural baseline.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; public dataset/code and extensive benchmark comparisons.

title: Infrared Small Target Detection with Scale and Location Sensitivity
relevance_note: Shows that loss design and a simple multi-scale head can materially change IRSTD performance; auxiliary router supervision cannot be presented as merely a training detail.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; multi-dataset evidence, ablations and public code.

title: Seeing Through the Noise: Improving Infrared Small Target Detection and Segmentation from Noise Suppression Perspective
relevance_note: Recent direct false-alarm competitor: suppresses noise through frequency-guided feature purification and spiral-aware feature fusion rather than attention projection.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; recent peer-reviewed work, with IRSTD-1K and SIRST-family evidence.

title: CCDNet: Learning to Detect Camouflage against Distractors in Infrared Small Target Detection
relevance_note: Closest recent wording-level competitor for distractor discrimination: uses local/global contrastive target-background similarity to reduce false alarms.
quality_note: Primary preprint record only as of the search date; useful novelty warning but weaker venue-status evidence.

title: DEAL: Difficulty-aware Active Learning for Semantic Segmentation
relevance_note: Direct precedent for supervising a pixel-wise attention/difficulty branch with the error between current segmentation and ground truth.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; task goal is active learning, which leaves room for a different IRSTD attention operator but forbids a generic first error-supervised-attention claim.

title: EAR-NET: Error Attention Refining Network for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
relevance_note: Direct precedent for using prediction-versus-GT differences as labels for a supervised error-attention map and then refining segmentation.
quality_note: Peer-reviewed IEEE conference paper; two-stage medical setting and modest breadth, but mechanism overlap is material.

title: Semantic Segmentation with Reverse Attention
relevance_note: Three branches learn direct, reverse and reverse-attention concepts; prevents claiming that multi-role/opposite semantic attention is new in itself.
quality_note: Primary BMVA proceedings PDF; broad segmentation experiments, but no IRSTD or constrained cross-scale attention.

title: Learning Dynamic Routing for Semantic Segmentation
relevance_note: Establishes differentiable, input-dependent soft routing across scale-transform paths; the word routing must be qualified as spatial evidence-role allocation rather than generic dynamic routing.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; strong multi-benchmark and efficiency evidence with public code.

title: Sparse and Constrained Attention for Neural Machine Translation
relevance_note: Defines constrained softmax as the KL-nearest distribution to softmax under simplex/upper-bound constraints; generic KL/I-projected constrained attention is established prior art.
quality_note: Primary ACL Anthology record and PDF; different task and constraint semantics, but exact mathematical overlap must be cited.

title: FPR: False Positive Rectification for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
relevance_note: Uses false-positive cues and positive/negative prototypes to suppress co-occurring background activations; blocks a broad claim that online false positives as supervision are novel.
quality_note: Primary CVF proceedings page; weakly supervised CAM setting differs from fully supervised IRSTD, but the false-positive-mining principle is close.
